$comment: Time-bounded exceptions for the CI dependency-audit gates. Every entry needs an owner, a rationale, the affected path and an expiry; scripts/check_dependency_audits.py FAILS on an expired waiver, so an exception cannot become permanent by neglect. Empty is the correct steady state.

pip_audit.rationale: No upstream fix exists: the advisory's own text says 'Patched versions: Not yet patched', and nltk 3.10.3 (the current release, which this lock now pins) clears the other 21 nltk advisories but not this one. It is a file-sandbox bypass in the model-artifact load/save helpers - TransitionParser.train/.parse, AveragedPerceptron.save/.load, PerceptronTagger.save_to_json and save_maxent_params - all of which are unreachable here: a repository-wide grep finds no reference to any of them, and nltk enters only transitively through llama-index-core's SentenceSplitter, which uses the punkt_tab and stopwords CORPORA. Exploiting it needs a caller-controlled model path; the app never passes one, and it seeds both corpora itself into NLTK_DATA_DIR (launch.py::_pin_nltk_data). Re-assess at expiry: drop the waiver the moment a patched nltk ships.
